name: trakt_movies
description: Build taste-oriented public movie discovery and movie-night ideas through Trakt. Use for 'what should I watch tonight?', 'find movies like Inception and Interstellar', 'I want a funny thriller under two hours', 'what movies are trending or popular on Trakt?', 'show related movies', movie details, or official trailer/video links. The recommend action blends bounded current Trakt lists with related movies from up to three supplied favorites, then returns a source-ranked candidate set for Jarvis to assess against the user's mood. This public Client-ID integration does not read a Trakt account's history, ratings, watchlist, or personalized recommendations. A streaming-list signal means recently ranked as streaming; it does not identify a provider or prove current availability in the user's subscriptions.

action.description: Public Trakt operation. Use recommend for a mood/preferences request; search for title or overview lookup; details, related, or videos for one movie; or a named discovery list.

request.description: Natural-language movie-night mood, constraints, and optional favorite films. Used by recommend. Quoted titles or phrases such as 'movies I loved: Inception, Interstellar' improve deterministic reference extraction.

query.description: Movie title or text query for search, or a title fallback for details, related, and videos when movie_id is omitted.

movie_id.description: Trakt movie slug or supported external ID for details, related, or videos. Prefer the ids.slug returned by an earlier result.

reference_titles.description: Up to three favorite movie titles used as similarity anchors by recommend.

genres.description: Optional Trakt genre slugs such as comedy, thriller, mystery, horror, romance, or science-fiction. Recommend infers common genre hints from request when omitted.

exclude_genres.description: Optional genre slugs to exclude locally after Trakt returns candidates. Recommend also understands explicit negative phrases such as 'no animation', 'without anime', or 'non-anime' and will not send them as positive Trakt genre filters.

years.description: Optional Trakt year or year range filter, for example 1990-2026.

runtimes.description: Optional runtime range in minutes, for example 60-120. Recommend infers common 'short' or 'under N minutes' constraints.

ratings.description: Optional Trakt rating percentage range, for example 70-100.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized results. Recommend clamps this to at least 3 and at most 15; default 8. Other actions default 10.

include_videos.description: For recommend, fetch bounded public video metadata for top candidates. Default true.

video_limit.description: How many top recommendation candidates receive video lookup. Default 3.

availability.setup_hint: Set TRAKT_API_KEY to the Trakt application Client ID in the active mode env file. Public metadata actions do not require a Client Secret or OAuth token.
